summary: The Timetable file manages various aspects of course and placement scheduling within cohorts in the HSPnet system. It facilitates data handling for timetables, including course details, scheduling, and allocation of resources.
purpose: To provide scheduling functionalities for cohorts, courses, and related activities in HSPnet.

workflows.name: Cohort Timetable Management
steps: Save, update, or delete timetable records as needed.

business_rules: Courses must adhere to term start and end dates.
Instructor roles must be unique across a course.
Shift lengths are calculated if start and end times are provided.
validations: Verify all required fields are completed for timetable entries.
Ensure no overlaps in block scheduling.
calculations: Shift lengths and total course durations.
system_behavior: Handles scheduling data for courses and rotations.
Supports automated email scheduling for supervisors.
